artifacts.summary: Six-phase, four-wave plan promoting the ray layer, the choice-free ray-layer gluing operator and the four [F.IsRegular] keystone declarations into two new FormalSystem modules, pinning their measured axiom sets into the C2 harness, landing the Deliverable 4 and 5 verdicts in the library, and adding the E1 backward-dual probe on a time-asymmetric fixture.

memory_candidates.content: In this Lean repository, TaskFrame.reflection is the unguarded reflection law and its proof opens with a classical eq_or_ne d 0, so any proof that rewrites with it measures Classical.choice. TaskFrame.reflection_of_ne (the off-zero wrapper, measured [propext]) does not. Any mixed-orientation task-relation rewrite whose case is strict can therefore be made choice-free by supplying a `d - d' ≠ 0` side condition via sub_ne_zero.mpr and rewriting with reflection_of_ne instead. This has now been the decisive repair twice on independent fronts (PlusLanguage.paste_rel, and the ray-layer seam gluing's glue_rel), each time turning [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] into [propext, Quot.sound] with a three-line substitution. The diagnostic is that the clean/dirty boundary sits at the exact declaration that performs the reflection rewrite, so #print axioms on the immediately preceding lemma localizes the leak in one step.
